public_rationale: Marcus predicted that AI model profits would stay modest or nonexistent in 2025, while chipmakers did well. Reporting on OpenAI's leaked 2025 financials puts its net loss at about $39 billion, and still about $8 billion after one-off charges. Microsoft's filing implies OpenAI lost about $11.5 billion in the September 2025 quarter alone. Nvidia's fiscal 2026, roughly calendar 2025, was highly profitable, with GAAP diluted EPS of $4.90. Both parts held.
limitations: OpenAI's figures are leaked or inferred, not official filings.
Other model makers and big tech's in-house model profits are not separately covered.

Calendar 2025 is the period; Nvidia's fiscal 2026 (ending January 2026) is the closest match.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Leading model developers report substantial 2025 profits, or chipmakers do poorly.
